title: Garbage Collection and Energy Consumption in Java: A Controlled Study Across Workloads and JDKs
abstract: arXiv:2608.19520v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Garbage-collector selection is a low-effort configuration decision that can influence both the performance and energy consumption of Java applications. However, it remains unclear whether aggregate energy rankings among collectors generalise across heterogeneous applications, workload intensities, and JDK distributions. This study presents a controlled empirical evaluation of Serial, Parallel, and G1 garbage collection across three Java applications, three workload intensities, and two JDK distributions: OpenJDK and Oracle JDK. Using EnergiBridge, processor-package energy consumption and execution time were measured and complementary energy-performance metrics derived. Across all evaluated configurations, Parallel recorded the lowest mean energy consumption (839.8 J), followed closely by Serial (857.6 J) and G1 (969.0 J), but an RCBD ANOVA did not establish a statistically reliable collector effect. translated_title: Java中的垃圾回收与能源消耗：跨工作负载与JDK的受控研究
translated_abstract: 垃圾回收器的选择是一个低成本的配置决策，可能影响Java应用程序的性能和能源消耗。然而，目前尚不清楚不同回收器之间的总体能源排名是否能在异构应用程序、工作负载强度和JDK发行版之间普遍适用。本研究对Serial、Parallel和G1垃圾回收器在三个Java应用程序、三种工作负载强度和两个JDK发行版（OpenJDK和Oracle JDK）下进行了受控实证评估。使用EnergiBridge测量处理器封装能源消耗和执行时间，并推导出互补的能源性能指标。在所有评估配置中，Parallel记录了最低的平均能源消耗（839.8焦耳），紧随其后的是Serial（857.6焦耳）和G1（969.0焦耳），但随机完全区组设计（RCBD）方差分析未确立统计上可靠的回收器效应。相比之下，工作负载强度是一个...
tldr: 本研究发现垃圾回收器选择对Java应用能源消耗无统计显著影响，而工作负载强度才是关键因素，挑战了回收器优化优先级的传统假设。
en_tdlr: This study finds that garbage collector selection has no statistically significant effect on Java application energy consumption, while workload intensity is the key factor, challenging traditional assumptions about collector optimization priorities.
